messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT detected: Elevated 5xx on PUT /upload in az-13 (eu-west-3) for v6 endpoints. Alert threshold crossed: 10% error rate over 2m. Pager: @oncall

sanjay (oncall): acked. Investigating. seeing spike starting ~11:42 UTC. Prior deploy? @deploy-bot any recent LB changes?

deploy-bot: No LB config changes in last 24h. Autoscaler scaled LBx-az13 up at 11:38.

anya (sre): can you reproduce with curl from inside az-13? Trying smaller vs larger payloads.

sanjay: repro: small PUT 512B ok, large PUT 1500B fails with 504/connection reset. curl shows "recv failure: Connection reset by peer". Fetching tcpdump on app-frontend-az13.

neteng: paging. likely MTU/fragmentation path issue. Are ICMP 'Fragmentation needed' messages making it back? run `tracepath6` and `sudo tcpdump -n -s0 -w /tmp/frag.pcap icmp6 and ip6` and check for 'Packet too big'.

sanjay: tracepath6 to storage-backend-v6: shows hop 4 pmtu 1280 then silence. tcpdump on frontend shows no ICMPv6 'packet too big' responses. Looks like PMTUD blackhole.

anya: mitigation options: 1) enable MSS clamping on LB to 1280 2) force IPv4 (disable v6 listen on LB for uploads) 3) temporary WAF rule to chunk uploads <1200B (ugh). I can patch LB in 30s if we choose.

sanjay: prioritize customer impact: CS says 12 orgs experiencing failed large file uploads (media). Impact: in-flight multipart uploads failing, retries causing CPU spike. ETA for mitigation?

julia-cs: Confirmed ~12 customers, mostly streaming uploads >1MB. Critical for two enterprise customers. We need external comms.

neteng: Recommend MSS clamp at edge, then validate. Will apply clamp to LB-az13-outbound egress. Command on envoy edge hosts:

```
sudo iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1280
```

We'll rollout via orchestration to all AZ13 edge nodes.

sanjay: applying MSS clamp now to lb-edge-01-az13 (one host) for canary.

ops-bot: deploy started: canary 1/5 hosts

sanjay: canary looks good — re-testing large PUT: SUCCESS. Error rate dropped from 12% -> 1.2% in az-13.

ops-bot: deploy finished: rollout 5/5 hosts

anya: post-mitigation checks: run `curl -v --http1.1 --data-binary @bigfile.dat https://upload.redwood.example/v6-uploads` success, tracepath6 now shows PMTU 1280 throughout.

julia-cs: sending customer update template now. Notifying impacted customers that we've applied a mitigation and are working on permanent fix.

neteng: root cause likely intermediate firewall/NGW in provider that drops ICMPv6 'packet too big' for large payloads; will open ticket with provider and request fix. Next steps: 1) Keep MSS clamp for az-13 until provider confirms 2) consider global MSS clamp for older AZs 3) add healthcheck: detect v6 PMTUD blackhole and auto-failover to v4 for upload route.

sanjay: oncall handoff to anya in 2h. I'm leaving notes on postmortem channel. If provider can't fix in 48h, escalate to infra eng for architectural change.

julia-cs: drafted customer notice: (sent) — will follow up with status updates.

ops-bot: Incident resolved: Error rate back to normal. Incident closed at 12:18 UTC. :white_check_mark:

sanjay: Thanks team. Opening postmortem.
